notes.title: Minor Patch for save files
notes.notes:
Hello!

We were made aware of an issue with the game when loading certain older save files. This patch fixes so they load properly.

A special thanks to all in the discussions forum who helped us pinpoint the issue!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hey! We wanted to publish a patch to follow up on our latest content update. This patch addresses:

- The studio looked a bit too well baked on the outside, so we turned down the heat somewhat.
- Adrienne should no longer improvise with lettering when making posters in polish
- Fixed an issue where a saboteur drew some extra lines on your fine art if you played on a low frame rate. This will retroactively fix paintings made since patch 1.0.2 and on (since october-ish).
- Someone (me) forgot to add the localization for the new things in Japanese. This has now been un-forgotten.

This is the final update for the year as we in the studio head into our blankets for the holidays. With that, thank you all for playing!

See you all next year!

notes.title: Hotfix patch - Studio Update
notes.notes:
Hey! We were made aware that an issue slipped past us that prevented players from using the Popup Table once bought. This hotfix addresses that.

Apologies for the inconvenience this caused! We'll continue listening and improving upon this content update. Hopefully it's smoother painting for you all from this point on!

notes.title: The Studio Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Bonjour my fellow artists! 

From the snowy landscapes I’m super stoked to announce our biggest update since the launch of the game. Say bonjour to:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581837/6b4d0eca3ac9f5cf4643756dddb458a8bd31c4b8.png

Sit down, grab a hot cup of tea as we explore what the update has to offer.

The studio is entirely remade. We wanted the studio to feel more special and like a historical part of Phénix. It also always felt a bit cramped to us (or what cheeky real estate agents would call “cozy”) so we made it larger to give you some breathing space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581837/d037ae63d4cdd63db6d7bb12edf934e03e3fd7d1.png

We want the studio to feel like a home, like it belongs to you. So from this patch you can customize your studio by choosing your interior decoration style as well as flooring and wallpaper.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581837/3a2fc6064a4521b87df950a811309b51fea2b237.png

Now to the cool part. This is an art game after all. In the studio you’ll be able to draw your own wallpaper pattern - making the studio completely unique to you! Honestly can’t wait to see what wallpaper designs you’ll cook up!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581837/b3ecdefe9e2cc9cc71dabebf9a8574ba37e95538.png

A studio of this size surely needs a little companion, don’t you think? Well there seems to be a feline fellow roaming around town. That bed of yours does seem like a perfect cozy spot for a cat, doesn’t it?

Finally, we’ve partnered with POSCA to bring their pens into the world of Passpartout! The POSCA pen has always been the main inspiration for the Round Brush so now we’re finally able to call the round brush by its true name: The POSCA Round Tip.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581837/dd52d6ef5e4f3d1d1dc17c031d269c6300ce8323.png
You’ll also find the POSCA Chisel Tip in Benjamin’s store as a new tool as well as a few new canvases. Hope you’ll like it! ❤️

Let me know what you think of the update. Are there any decoration options you’d like to see in the future?

In the meantime I wish you all a very warm happy holidays. We’ll be back after the new year.

Cozy painting!
//Papa Mattias

notes.title: Language & Settings hotfix
notes.notes:
We found the languages that got lost after the previous update. They have now been returned to their home in the settings menu.

This patch also contains some improvements to how settings are loaded and applied, which should help users who experienced issues entering that menu.

notes.title: Summer Language Update
notes.notes:
Bonjour my fellow artists 🍷🥖

In our home of Sweden, we’ve just celebrated midsummer which marks the longest days where the sun barely sets! Soon the whole team will be heading off on some well deserved summer holiday. Have you made your summer plans yet?🏖️ For me, we’ll be taking the baby on the road a cozy trip around the country. Good food ✅, chilling ✅ and carefree existence ✅.

To celebrate the summer and the season of travel we’ve added a bunch of new languages in this pre-summer update. The additional languages are Turkish, Italian, Spanish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish and Dutch. With this we hope that even more people can enjoy the game, especially all the monolingual little humans out there looking to embark on their artistic journey. We are working on a content update as well. It just needs a bit more love before it’s ready to face the world and we’re planning on releasing it during autumn.

OH! And in case you missed it, Passpartout 2 is coming to Nintendo Switch this fall!!! So, uh, that’s also a bit of a reason why the updates have been a bit slower as we’ve been tinkering away getting the game to run well on the Switch.

Happy coloring, and keep swinging that brush (you’re looking really cool doing it)!

//Papa Mattias

notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.notes:
Bonjour!

Mattias here with another small update including some fixes you've been reporting!


Fixed various minor localization issues.
Trying a fix so the band member stops going wild playing their own music.
Fixed so the brush selection UI never gets a weird grey flickering background.
Fixed so you can't ruin your save by accidentally burning key items over at Hope.
Fixed so the canvas buttons don't think they are bigger than they are.
Fixed an issue where Passpartout's extravagant painting poses would cause some PCs to crash.
Save files should now be more stable.

Thank you to everyone who helped out with reporting issues. We'll continue keeping a track of the bugs you report and still have many to squash ahead!

Happy painting!
//Mattias

notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.notes:
Bonjour! First of all, a huge thank you for the lovely reception. Launching Passpartout 2 has gone beyond even our wildest expectations! <3 

Unfortunately we didn't manage to find and squish all the bugs before release. In this patch we're fixing some of the most critical ones - leading to the game locking itself, namely:

 Chatting to Margaret about Brianna's mission no longer leads to an eternal staring contest.
 Lancecour no longer soft-locks when playing in Korean.
 Added crash diagnostics to get better details of what may be causing a few users experiencing crashes when painting.


We'll keep a close eye on all the bugs and issues you run into while playing, we're lurking all the forums and communities to gather a nice list of things to fix. Here's a few we've noted so far that we'll look into in the future:

 The hitbox on the buttons on the right side of the canvas take way more space than they should, leading to accidental clicks.
 One of the band members can sometimes get too excited and start playing their own music at the same time.
 Canvases in the overworld have a not-so-nice-looking stripe-y effect.
 Lancecour can go full exorcist with his head while sitting down. Creepy stuff.


Again, huge thank you for your support! With this the development team will be checking out for Easter Holidays for a well deserved long weekend. Next week we'll be back and energized.

Happy painting!
/Papa Mattias

notes.title: What is That?! A Release Date???
notes.notes:
Bonjour my fellow artists!🍷🥖


It’s time to sharpen your pencils✏️ The day we’ve all been waiting for is coming super soon! This is as exciting as announcements get!




✨Passpartout 2 releases on Steam April 4🎨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28422089/ca41a62cfeb20f23bc1fa6aa5804a94a09697112.png


At this very moment, we’re all smacking our keyboards as hard as we can - ironing out the final bugs to give you all as comfy and sweet an experience as we can. We’ve also finally decided on a price point. 
So, allow me to share some details about the release:


🕰 It’ll release on Steam at 10AM PST/ 6PM GMT/ 7PM CET
💶 Price  $24.99 / €24.99/ £20.99
👼 20% Sale discount for 1 week
🖥 Will officially support Windows and Mac



[previewyoutube=d-9rec1LU0Y;full][/previewyoutube]


As you can see in the announcement trailer there are quite a few new areas and characters you didn’t get a chance to meet in the demo last summer. We can’t wait until you get to try it!🏘

Please tell everyone to wishlist the game. Tell your friends, your grandma, your cat and even your car (smart cars can wishlist games now?)! Everything helps us continue making the games we love💕


Your support so far has been amazing and we’re infinitely grateful! You’ve helped us crack down on nasty bugs. You banded together and made Bull St. a sprawling business zone with a whopping 24 amazing ad posters! Thank you!


Allow me to take a moment as well to share the amazing posters made by you and the community. To be frank we were overwhelmed by how many great submissions we received!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28422089/6546ebc2fd94ae4de32ec19db7969593b8875b83.png


For those of you who missed it, if your poster was selected you’ll be notified by e-mail with info & a steam key around the time of release 📨


Now let's keep the hype up for release! And don’t forget to keep on drawing!


// Papa Mattias
